❓ FAQ

Is Prime Gaming the same as Amazon Luna?
Yes. Amazon folded Prime Gaming's free games into Amazon Luna. Prime members still claim free PC games every month, now from the Luna claims page.
Where do I redeem Prime Gaming games?
Each game redeems on a specific store, shown on its card: usually Epic Games Store or GOG, sometimes the Amazon Games app, Xbox app or Legacy Games.
Do I keep the games if I cancel Prime?
Yes. Once claimed and redeemed, the games are yours to keep even if your Prime membership ends.
